Cylinder
Fixture feature: a cylinder (synthetic description).

SYNTAX
model.component(<ctag>).geom(<tag>).create(<ftag>,"Cylinder");

DESCRIPTION
TABLE 3-40: VALID PROPERTY/VALUE PAIRS FOR CYLINDER.

PROPERTY                 VALUE                   DEFAULT     DESCRIPTION

r                        double                  1           Fixture text for Cylinder.r.
h                        double                  1           Fixture text for Cylinder.h.
pos                      double[]                {0,0,0}     Fixture text for Cylinder.pos.
axis                     double[]                {0,0,1}     Fixture text for Cylinder.axis.
ang                      double                  360         Fixture text for Cylinder.ang.
type                     solid | surface         solid       Fixture text for Cylinder.type.

EXAMPLE
The following commands create a cylinder.


                                                                                   FIXTURE SECTION HEADER     |   301

Sphere
Fixture feature: a sphere (synthetic description).

SYNTAX
model.component(<ctag>).geom(<tag>).create(<ftag>,"Sphere");

DESCRIPTION
TABLE 3-42: VALID PROPERTY/VALUE PAIRS FOR SPHERE.

PROPERTY                 VALUE                   DEFAULT     DESCRIPTION

r                        double                  1           Fixture text for Sphere.r.
pos                      double[]                {0,0,0}     Fixture text for Sphere.pos.
rot                      double                  0           Fixture text for Sphere.rot.
type                     solid | surface         solid       Fixture text for Sphere.type.


Cone
Fixture feature: a cone (synthetic description).

SYNTAX
model.component(<ctag>).geom(<tag>).create(<ftag>,"Cone");

DESCRIPTION
TABLE 3-44: VALID PROPERTY/VALUE PAIRS FOR CONE.

PROPERTY                 VALUE                   DEFAULT     DESCRIPTION

r                        double                  1           Fixture text for Cone.r.
h                        double                  2           Fixture text for Cone.h.
ang                      double                  360         Fixture text for Cone.ang.
rattop                   double                  0           Fixture text for Cone.rattop.
pos                      double[]                {0,0,0}     Fixture text for Cone.pos.
specifytop               none | radius |         none        Fixture text for Cone.specifytop with a
                         width                               wrapped value column.
